title: Targets spec version 1.1.0; this validator implements 1.0.0
description: Well-formed 1.0 shape, so the 1.0 schema would accept it silently. VERSIONING §8.5 forbids that: a consumer that ships only the 1.0 schema must not treat a higher minor as 1.0, because a 1.1 document may carry members and enum values 1.0 never had.
